One change, in one function, in one file.

THE SPLITTER. renderComposedPdf in scripts/build-census-v1-agency-application-treatment:obligation:research-decision-route:CO:co_mistaken_identity_expungement:participant_investigation_and_finding_request.mjs defined its own splitToken that accumulated CHARACTERS and cut at whichever glyph first reached the 468pt margin (612pt page, 72pt margins, Times-Roman 11pt). It is deleted. In its place the builder imports the shared separator-aware splitter, createTokenSplitter({ fits: fitsByFontMetrics(font, fontSize, maxWidth) }) from scripts/rcap-custom-pleading/split-token.mjs, built from this builder's own font handle, font size and column width. A route key too long for the column now breaks only after one of its own separators - colon, underscore, slash, dot or hyphen - so the broken line ends on the separator and announces itself as continuing. The call site inside wrap() is untouched: the same local name is now bound to the shared splitter.

THE ASSERTION. assert.equal(splitToken.hardSplits, 0, ...) runs after every composed document is laid out and before the document is saved. The splitter is constructed inside renderComposedPdf, so the counter is per composed document. A future route key with no separator to break on inside the column now FAILS THE BUILD instead of shipping chopped. hardSplits is zero on both fixtures today, which is why the build completes.

WHAT WAS NOT CHANGED. No pagination constant, no wrap rule, no line height, no column width, no component set, no field map, no source pin, no route key, no appearance-registry entry, and not one line of participant-instructions.md. The diff is 10 insertions and 9 deletions in the builder, 6 of the insertions a comment.

WHAT THE DELIVERED PAGES CARRIED BEFORE, read off the superseded bytes: "...co_mistaken_identity_expungement:participant_investigation_and" / "_finding_request" - line one ended with no separator, line two opened on an orphan underscore.

WHAT THEY CARRY NOW: "...co_mistaken_identity_expungement:participant_investigation_" / "and_finding_request" - the break is now after the token's own underscore. The defect was present on pages 2, 4 of both fixtures and is gone from both.

rows.whatChanged:
One change, in one function, in one file.

THE SPLITTER. renderComposedPdf in scripts/build-census-v1-composed-treatment:obligation:runtime-contract-cohort:DE:juvenile-expungement-under-10-del-c-1017-1019-1017a:section_1018_discretionary_petition.mjs defined its own splitToken that accumulated CHARACTERS and cut at whichever glyph first reached the 468pt margin (612pt page, 72pt margins, Times-Roman 11pt). It is deleted. In its place the builder imports the shared separator-aware splitter, createTokenSplitter({ fits: fitsByFontMetrics(font, fontSize, maxWidth) }) from scripts/rcap-custom-pleading/split-token.mjs, built from this builder's own font handle, font size and column width. A route key too long for the column now breaks only after one of its own separators - colon, underscore, slash, dot or hyphen - so the broken line ends on the separator and announces itself as continuing. The call site inside wrap() is untouched: the same local name is now bound to the shared splitter.

THE ASSERTION. assert.equal(splitToken.hardSplits, 0, ...) runs after every composed document is laid out and before the document is saved. The splitter is constructed inside renderComposedPdf, so the counter is per composed document. A future route key with no separator to break on inside the column now FAILS THE BUILD instead of shipping chopped. hardSplits is zero on both fixtures today, which is why the build completes.

WHAT WAS NOT CHANGED. No pagination constant, no wrap rule, no line height, no column width, no component set, no field map, no source pin, no route key, no appearance-registry entry, and not one line of participant-instructions.md. The diff is 10 insertions and 9 deletions in the builder, 6 of the insertions a comment.
